meta.title: IT Services Public Sector | Digital Gov - Coday

hero.headline: Digital Sovereignty
hero.subline: Legally compliant & accessible solutions for public administration.

pricing.title: Transparent Cost Calculation
pricing.disclaimer: No flat rates. We calculate exactly according to your specifications (EVB-IT).

services.title: Service Spectrum
services.headline: Digital Administration Reimagined.
services.subline: From application to decision: We digitize processes end-to-end, media-break-free and user-centric (OZG-compliant).

portals.title: Citizen Portals & OZG
portals.desc: Accessible frontends for citizen services. Integration of BundID and user accounts.

internal.title: Specialized Procedures
internal.desc: Efficient internal tools for case workers. Automated workflows and E-File connection.

smartcity.title: Smart City & IoT
smartcity.desc: Connected infrastructure and Open Data platforms for the city of the future.

tech_stack.title: Technological Sovereignty
tech_stack.headline: Open Source First. No Vendor Lock-in.
tech_stack.description: We rely on proven open source technologies that guarantee full control over your data and infrastructure. Auditable, secure, and free of license fees.

kubernetes.title: Container Orchestration
kubernetes.desc: Scalable microservices architectures with strict network policy isolation. BSI-compliant deployments.

iam.title: Identity & Access
iam.desc: Central identity management with OIDC/SAML integration. Support for FIDO2 and eIDAS authentication.

chat.title: Secure Communication
chat.desc: End-to-end encrypted real-time communication. Federated and independent of US cloud providers.

hosting.title: Server Location
hosting.desc: Hosting in ISO 27001 certified data centers in Germany (e.g. Hetzner, T-Systems). Air-gapped option available.

ozg.title: OZG 2.0 Maturity
ozg.headline: From Paper Forms to 'Once-Only'.
ozg.description: We guide you through all stages of OZG implementation. Our goal is Level 4: Complete dark processing.

info.title: Level 1: Information
info.desc: Accessible provision of all information (BITV 2.0). Easy Read and Sign Language integration.

interaction.title: Level 2: Interaction
interaction.desc: Download of forms and contact initiation. Intelligent chatbots for citizen support.

transaction.title: Level 3: Transaction
transaction.desc: Complete digital application with eID / BundID integration. End-to-end encrypted data transfer.

transformation.title: Level 4: Transformation
transformation.desc: Media-break-free process chain. Register retrieval instead of proof obligation (Once-Only). Automated decision making.

pricing_reality.title: Procurement & Costs
pricing_reality.headline: Why Fixed Prices Fail in Public Service.
pricing_reality.description: Public contracts require EVB-IT compliance and price indication based on performance specifications. Fixed offers often lead to subsequent cost explosions or procurement law violations.

rows.coday: Agile according to Specs / User Stories

wizard.title: Tender Assistant
wizard.headline: Which procedure fits your project?
wizard.description: Find the right tender type for your IT project in 3 clicks. Based on current thresholds (as of 2024).

budget.question: What is the estimated contract volume (net)?

type.question: What type of service is it?

direct.title: Direct Award Possible
direct.desc: Up to this limit, you can often award contracts informally. Ideal for PoCs, workshops, or small modules.

uvgo.title: Negotiated Tender (UVgO)
uvgo.desc: Flexible competition is necessary. We support you in drafting the performance specifications for the negotiated tender.

vgv.title: EU Tender (VgV)
vgv.desc: The project exceeds the threshold. A complex VgV procedure is required. We have experience with e-tender platforms.

lastenheft.title: Spec Template for IT Tenders
lastenheft.desc: Save time with our EVB-IT compliant template for software development.
